name: KSUM Seed Fund (soft loan)
summary: A soft loan of up to ₹15 lakh at 6% simple interest for product startups, with a 12-month moratorium and 36 monthly repayments.
benefits: Up to ₹15 lakh at 6% simple interest
eligibility: Kerala LLP or private limited company with a KSUM ID and DPIIT recognition
Innovative product or technology (not pure services or trading)
